fields.label: Speech to text provider
fields.description: sarvam-saaras-v3 or deepgram-nova-3. SOS-N21 chooses. The fake works only on a site that allows tests (SOS-P5-07).

fields.label: Voice agent model
fields.description: The fast Anthropic model the voice agent speaks with. SOS-N21 chooses.

fields.label: Voice
fields.description: The Sarvam speaker or the ElevenLabs voice ID. Empty uses the provider's default.

fields.label: AI disclosure line
fields.default: Namaste, main Nicole baat kar rahi hoon. Main {company} ka AI assistant hoon. Yeh call quality ke liye record ho rahi hai. Agar aap kisi insaan se baat karna chahein, toh bas bol dijiye.
fields.description: Spoken first on every call, in Roman Hinglish (SOS-N21C, Jayman, 24 November 2026). {company} is replaced with the company name; the persona name Nicole is part of the text. Counsel reviews it before launch. While it is empty the voice agent places no live call.
